newsitem.title: USA: Del Monte Corp sells $150 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: Del Monte Corp sells $150 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: The following 144a private placement of high-yield bonds from Del Monte Corp was priced on Tuesday via BT Securities Inc, market sources said.
Proceeds from the transaction will be used to finance a leveraged buyout of the company by an investor group led by Texas Pacific Group.

The size of the high-yield offering was reduced to $150 million from an original size of $215 million, market sources said. Other financing for the buyout includes the purchase of $35 million of Del Monte 14 percent pay-in-kind preferred stock by Texas Pacific as well as a bank loan, they added.
Del Monte is a packaged food products company.
